items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: And Jackson Pollock was a jazz fan and so they’re doing four Fridays in January.

ctx.x: What’s up for you in the near future?

Well next week I go to three concerts in Raleigh, North Carolina in that area. And two weeks later out in Seattle, Washington for two more. I have a very interesting concert on January 1st at the Museum of Modern Art in New York in connection with the Jackson Pollock art exhibit that opens I think tomorrow on the first of November. And Jackson Pollock was a jazz fan and so they’re doing four Fridays in January. We’re doing it January 1st, the music that Jackson Pollock liked. Evidently he loved jazz and liked…
Well you can’t sit still, that’s for sure.
